conditions.description: No external current; paired with the same seed-bound weight realization as treatment.
Base current 50.0 scaled by the registered seed-bound drive realization.

seed_strategy.rule: Legacy registry field minimum_independent_seeds denotes ten distinct deterministic seed-bound parameter realizations, not independent biological samples.

parameterization.pairing: control and tonic treatment share one seed-bound realization
parameterization.uniqueness_requirement: all ten parameter digests unique before execution

stopping_rule: Complete 100000 ticks for both conditions and all ten registered realizations; retain any runtime, numerical, topology or contract failure.
inclusion_criteria: 10000 tick burn-in excluded from primary stability statistics
exactly ten unique seed-bound parameter digests
paired control and tonic-drive run for every registered seed
clean frozen code and configuration provenance
exclusion_criteria: runtime error or incomplete tick budget
unexpected neuron or synapse count change
missing raw trace or seed/condition record
duplicate parameter digest across registered seeds
dirty source tree or unreviewed protocol amendment

descriptive_statistics: per-realization tonic spike-window mean, CV and drift
analysis_plan.inference_policy: Support requires every registered run to satisfy execution, finiteness and topology criteria, all ten parameter digests to be unique, and every tonic-drive realization to satisfy activity, CV and drift thresholds. Failed realizations are retained. No biological or independent-sampling generalization is permitted.

expected_failure_modes: rate drift or unstable activity under jitter

ai_treatment.authority_boundary: AI cannot alter seeds, jitter range, thresholds, exclusions or evidence status.
